title: NektarIR: A Domain-Specific Compiler for High-Order Finite Element Operations on Heterogeneous Hardware
summary: Modern high performance computing (HPC) applications must target heterogeneous hardware. This requires significant work to ensure domain specific implementations translate to highly performant kernels across a range hardware types and vendors, each requiring bespoke optimization to make use of the specific target architecture. Through the development of a domain specific compiler built with the multi-level intermediate representations (MLIR) project, one can express a high-level, close to the specific domain, abstraction that is progressively lowered to a low, close to metal, abstraction.
